deviations: PrivateDir (scanner private_fs.rs, not owned) exposes no fd accessor, so directory fsync reopens the held descriptor via its /proc/self/fd/N path (same mechanism as proc_path) and calls File::sync_all.
I-3 also maps attempt-read failures that happen while opening attempts/ (e.g. unsafe attempts/ dir) to exit 3, since an attempt may exist behind it.
tx-status/rebroadcast 'attempt file is invalid' (unparseable txid/raw_hex in a readable file) also moved to exit 3 for consistency with I-3; rebroadcast 'attempt has expired' stays exit 2 as before.
Existing test 'an expired attempt does not block...' now uses a different invoice's digest for the expired record (same-digest re-send is now refused by I-2); renamed accordingly.
Rust files were reformatted with rustfmt --edition 2024 (only touched files).
